method: OpenAI built-in image generation; contemporary collection illustrations

high-valleys.alt: An engraved Alpine path crosses a stone bridge toward timber houses beneath mountain ridges.
high-valleys.caption: Beyond the familiar.

fireside-reading.caption: A few minutes by the fireside.

mountain-folk.alt: A small, elderly mountain dweller offers a wooden cup to a herder beneath a larch tree.
mountain-folk.caption: Helpers beyond the village.

wit-and-good-fortune.caption: A fortunate crossing.
